title: crocanthemum glomeratum
intro: Crocanthemum glomeratum, commonly known as Rock Rose or Pineland Rosemary, is a flowering plant species native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Crocanthemum glomeratum include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as reducing stress and anxiety, and improving cognitive function. The plant's therapeutic actions are also attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues and promote relaxation, making it a popular choice for herbal remedies.
